values.note: 66 tent/RV sites and 37 lean-tos in three areas (A, B, C) strung along the ridge. The booking site lists 65: 43 take an RV, 22 are tent-only. RV sites list 20-35 ft; 25 of the 43 list 28 ft or more, 15 list 20 ft. T40 (35 ft) and T54 (20 ft) are pull-throughs.

note: On a wooded ridge above Emerald Lake, in three camping areas strung along the ridge road; none are on the water. The lake below has a small beach, a seasonal snack bar and boat rentals, between US 7 and the railway. --Claude
